name: iTechSmart UAIO Agent
description: Agent-to-Agent access to the iTechSmart Unified Autonomous IT Operations pipeline. Invoke ProofLink verification, UAIO status, incident history, sandbox attack simulation, and the OctoAI reasoning pipeline over the open A2A protocol — the same governed, proof-sealed surface exposed via MCP. Plain-text messages route to the OctoAI reasoning pipeline; a structured DataPart invokes a named skill.

bearer.description: iTechSmart MCP API key as Bearer token

skills.name: verify_prooflink_receipt
skills.description: Verify the cryptographic integrity of a ProofLink receipt from iTechSmart's autonomous IT operations platform.

skills.name: get_receipt_chain
skills.description: Fetch and verify the complete ProofLink receipt chain from iTechSmart's production ledger.

skills.name: prooflink.verify_chain
skills.description: Read-only audit scope: verify the ProofLink receipt chain for EU AI Act Article 12, CISO, and auditor workflows.

skills.name: prooflink.verify_receipt
skills.description: Read-only audit scope: verify one ProofLink receipt by ID without granting mutation rights.

skills.name: prooflink.search_receipts
skills.description: Read-only audit scope: search recent ProofLink receipts for ledger-backed post-hoc reconstruction.

skills.name: mission.list_incidents
skills.description: Read-only mission scope: list recent autonomous IT incidents for audit and operations review.

skills.name: mission.cluster_health
skills.description: Read-only mission scope: return live cluster health without granting execution or remediation rights.

skills.name: compliance.audit_summary
skills.description: Read-only compliance scope: return the live compliance audit summary for CISO/auditor review.

skills.name: query_uaio_status
skills.description: Get the current operational status of the iTechSmart UAIO (Unified Autonomous IT Operations) platform.

skills.name: get_incident_details
skills.description:
Fetch details of a specific autonomous remediation incident including the ProofLink receipt, remediation actions taken, before/after system state, time to detect, time to remediate, and NIST control mappings.

Requires scope: incident:classify:read.

skills.name: list_recent_incidents
skills.description: List recent autonomous IT remediation incidents from the iTechSmart UAIO platform.

skills.name: simulate_infrastructure_attack
skills.description: Trigger a simulated infrastructure attack on the iTechSmart break-it sandbox to demonstrate the UAIO autonomous loop.

skills.name: invoke_octoai_pipeline
skills.description: Invoke the OctoAI 7-node cognitive pipeline with a free-form prompt.

skills.name: get_platform_briefing
skills.description: Get a full real-time platform health briefing for the iTechSmart UAIO platform.

skills.name: get_sie_queue
skills.description: Retrieve the current SIE (Self-Improving Engine) security finding queue.

skills.name: get_compliance_status
skills.description: Get live compliance scores for the iTechSmart platform.

skills.name: dispatch_ag2_incident
skills.description: Dispatch an IT incident to the iTechSmart AG2 6-agent GroupChat for autonomous diagnosis.

skills.name: search_platform_logs
skills.description: Search live systemd journal logs for any iTechSmart service.

skills.name: approve_sie_finding
skills.description: Approve a specific SIE (Self-Improving Engine) security finding by queue index.

skills.name: trigger_sie_scan
skills.description: Kick off a fresh SIE (Self-Improving Engine) scan of the iTechSmart platform.

skills.name: get_iself_journal
skills.description: Retrieve the iSELF (Self-Healing Loop Framework) healing history.

skills.name: integration_status

skills.name: langfuse_health
